what: Per-player game logs from the official 2026-11-15 game books: minutes, points, rebounds, assists, plus-minus and the DNP/inactive reason, for the four clubs that had no captured game book before this round (BOS, DAL, HOU, WAS, IND, PHI, LAL, PHX -- eight club-games).
verification: a club-game is published verified only if every row satisfies TOT = OR + DR and PTS = 2*FG + 3P + FT, and the column sums equal the team-total row the same PDF prints, with minutes summing to 240:00
